name: Skill Orchestrator
description: Discovers, validates, audits, and resolves conflicts across all workspace skills. Ensures smooth operation when you have many custom skills.

skillsDir.description: Path to skills directory. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills

autoFix.description: Automatically apply safe fixes when conflicts are detected

similarityThreshold.description: Trigger similarity threshold for conflict detection (0.0-1.0)
